stability: Within callwitness.baseline.v1, fields may be added but existing field names, units (bytes, milliseconds) and meanings will not change. A breaking change becomes v2 at a new path; v1 keeps resolving. The raw census JSONL carries no such promise -- depend on this document, not on that file.
caveat: Delivered sizes come from 140 successful calls across 65 servers, measured on one machine. This is the only published measurement of what MCP servers actually return rather than what they declare, which makes it the best number available and still a small one. Report n alongside any value taken from here.
